messages:
samir: Deploybot flagged image push for release/2026.03.20 as 'annotation-mismatch' — holding the deploy. Anyone from releases available to triage? https://ci.internal/redwood/1234

release-coordinator: I'm on it. Change window open until 20:30 PT. Which image tag?

maria: It's `123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/service-api:2026.03.20-rc1`. CI shows cosign signature, but ECR provenance check rejected due to missing KMS annotation (kms_key_id). Build used alias `alias/builder-old`.

devops-bot: deploybot: publish rejected by ecr-provenance-checker (error=missing_kms_annotation, field=kms_key)

maria: log snippet:
```
ERROR: publish failed: provenance check failed: missing annotation "kms_key_id"
metadata: {"cosign_sig":true,"kms":null}
```

tony: We can't bypass the check. Two options: 1) retag to previous pinned digest and roll forward; 2) republish with correct KMS key. Security won't allow non-KMS attestation fallback.

lucy: Proposal: manual republish with correct KMS key `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/new-kms-2026`, verify attestations, then promote to canary in us-east-1 (3 pods) for 2h, then mirror to eu-west and resume full rollout. I'll update release notes: "AUTO-PUBLISH SKIPPED: manual republish to fix KMS annotation mismatch; no functional change."

samir: Sounds good. @maria can you kick off the manual republish? @deploybot please pause automatic retries until we confirm.

deploybot: deploybot: automatic retries paused by samir. Waiting for manual republish.

maria: Running manual publish now. Command:
```
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-tag 2026.03.20-rc1 --image-manifest file://image-manifest.json
cosign sign --key ksm:///alias/new-kms-2026 image-ref
```

maria: Republish complete. Cosign verify shows key fingerprint `SHA256:aa:bb:cc:...`. ECR metadata includes `kms_key_id=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/new-kms-2026`.

tony: Verified. Attestation present and KMS annotation exists. Starting canary rollout to staging cluster (3 pods): `kubectl set image ...`.

samir: Canary running. Hold for 2 hours. If no regressions, we'll resume full rollout at change window end and update release notes accordingly.

lucy: Filing followup ticket to pin builder pipeline to use `alias/new-kms-2026` and add pipeline validation to catch missing annotations. I'll write a short postmortem.

security: Thanks for the heads-up. We'll audit key usage and ensure the key policy is scoped. Please include the cosign key fingerprint in the release notes.

deploybot: deploybot: manual promotion triggered by maria; publish and rollout complete. release/2026.03.20 promoted to production. image digest sha256:abcd1234ef567890... (pinned). Release notes updated.

samir: Great work, team. Closing thread once CI deploy monitor confirms all services healthy.

release-coordinator: Service health green across regions. Closing.
